title: Plate Solve Sync Offset After Slew
dataSources: NINA sequences (`nina:sequence`), NINA autofocus runs (`nina:autofocus`), Ekos scheduler and device events (`ekos:scheduler`, `ekos:device`), PHD2 guiding telemetry (`phd2:guide`), plate solves (`platesolve:run`), filter wheel events (`filterwheel:event`), and flat frames (`flatlib:frame`).
app: Astrophotography session telemetry from N.I.N.A., KStars/Ekos, PHD2, plate-solving tools, ASCOM gear, and filter-wheel controllers sent to Splunk HEC via logs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=platesolve:run
| search sync_error_arcmin=*
| stats avg(sync_error_arcmin) as avg_sync_error_arcmin max(sync_error_arcmin) as max_sync_error_arcmin by mount_name
| sort 0 - avg_sync_error_arcmin
description: Ranks mountss by sync offset after slew.
value: Large sync offsets after slews often point to pointing model or driver issues that are easy to ignore until a target is lost.
implementation: Send sync offset after slew events to `index=personal` and keep `mount_name` populated so the leaderboard stays actionable.
visualization: Bar chart of sync offset after slew by mounts.
grandmaExplanation: It turns which mountss stand out most for sync offset after slew.
